description: Glucose log + insulin calculator PWA. Vanilla, IndexedDB, no backend.

tasks.task: Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS scaffold, no build step
Piecewise insulin formula (mmol/L input)
IndexedDB readings store with timestamp index
7-day SVG line chart with hi/lo threshold lines
History list with delete-per-row
CSV export of all readings
Service worker + manifest (installable PWA)
Local smoke test via Chrome DevTools — formula and UI verified
Initial commit
Create GitHub repo D-MK/sweet-t-v2
Push to main, enable GitHub Pages
Verify deploy at https://d-mk.github.io/sweet-t-v2/
Real PWA icons (replace placeholder ST glyph)
Edit reading (currently delete-only)
CSV import (round-trip from export)
Optional cloud sync via VPS or D1 (only if multi-device need arises)
tasks.note: VPS sync via personal-watch backend, fire-and-forget outbox, offline-first preserved

phases.name: Record insulin taken (Humalog + Lantus)
phases.note: Distinct from the calculated `insulin` suggestion. Graph = bars-at-bottom track. Insulin-only entries (no glucose) supported for bedtime Lantus.

tasks.task: Data model: add optional humalog_units + lantus_units; valid record = glucose>0 OR a dose>0 (no IndexedDB migration needed)
Result panel: Humalog input prefilled with suggested dose, Lantus input blank
'+ Log insulin only' collapsible path: doses + time + note, no glucose
Chart: 28px insulin track below glucose line, color-coded bars per type, legend; glucose line skips null-glucose records
Edit mode: add humalog/lantus fields
CSV export/import: add humalog_units,lantus_units columns; keep row if glucose OR dose present
Sync: insulin-only records (no mg_dl) skip enqueue — glucose-only sync unchanged
Verify: node --check modules + Chrome DevTools smoke (bars render, insulin-only entry in history) + screenshot
Service worker: make navigation requests network-first (fall back to cache when offline) so deployed HTML/JS updates show on the first launch instead of lagging a launch behind; keep offline support
tasks.note: Root cause of installed-PWA showing stale version after a deploy. Current SW is cache-first (return cached || network); the v1->v2 cache bump only self-heals after the new SW activates.

tasks.task: Real PWA icons (replace placeholder ST glyph) — carried from Phase 3

phases.name: Food-target dosing rules
phases.note: Safety-driven: no correction insulin at or below target, treat hypos with carbs not insulin.

tasks.task: Glucose <= 6.5 mmol/L: recommend 0u and do NOT auto-fill the Humalog field (won't be injecting)
Glucose < 4 mmol/L: show red 'eat 1 bread unit (10 g carbohydrate)' recommendation
Verify: Chrome DevTools smoke at 3.5 / 6.5 / 9.0 mmol + screenshots
